data.content:
* * *

## [The plates look nice but aren’t quality](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/651231aa947b1279b909c859)
The plates look nice but aren’t super usable - after my first use they have scratches from simple fork/knife use (I didn’t eat anything aggressive just a samon+salad). I didn’t expect this at all, haven’t seen dinnerware behave like this (and definitely not at this price point) but unfortunately I do regret picking this over the other that I was considering that might’ve held up beyond one use. The fact that its final sale makes it even more annoying that I have to eat this cost. Again love the design but I don’t think the quality is worth it.

September 5, 2023

* * *

Hi Nathalyn,

Thank you for reaching out. We're sorry to hear the Aluna dinner set did not meet your expectations. We will share this feedback with our team for further review. If you have any further feedback or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
